Markets.title: US stocks today: Dow Jones crashes 500 pts, Nasdaq over 2.5% as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
Markets.summary: US stocks tumbled on Friday, led by a steep tech sell-off as disappointing results from Intel and Amazon fueled concerns over rising artificial intelligence spending. Consequently, the Dow Jones dropped 500 points and the Nasdaq fell over 2.5%, sealing negative returns for October for both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500.

Markets.title: Nasdaq 100 cracks 5%, wipes out $2 trillion in October as AI spending fears deepen
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq 100 dropped more than 5% in October, wiping out $2 trillion in market value due to rising borrowing costs and investor anxiety over massive artificial intelligence spending. Major tech companies like Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft continue to increase their capital outlays to build out AI infrastructure despite these financial concerns.

Markets.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth
Markets.summary: Reddit shares dropped after the company warned that Google's AI-powered search features are reducing referral traffic and threatening daily active user growth. Additionally, Pinterest shares fell following a weaker revenue outlook caused by pressure on European cross-border sellers.

Markets.title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
Markets.summary: Intel shares plummeted 30% after the company issued a weak revenue forecast and warned of negative annual cash flow. This announcement sparked a global semiconductor selloff, dragging down competitors like Nvidia and AMD due to concerns over weak PC demand and high AI costs.

Markets.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
Markets.summary: Sun Pharma reported a 36% drop in second-quarter net profit to Rs 1,989 crore, driven down by exceptional litigation and acquisition costs. Although revenue grew by 11.8% on strong domestic and emerging market sales, US formulations experienced weaker performance.

Markets.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
Markets.summary: Syrma SGS Technology reported a record-high quarterly consolidated revenue of Rs 1,999.5 crore for the period ending September 2026, marking a 73.2% increase year-on-year. During the same quarter, the company's consolidated net profit rose by 87.2% and exports grew by 91%.

Geo-Political.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has approved the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine. These American-made interceptors are currently the only effective weapon Ukraine has to shoot down Russian ballistic missiles.

Geo-Political.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
Geo-Political.summary: Binance is trying to recover $6.3 billion stolen in what is believed to be the largest cryptocurrency cyber-attack in history. The complex hack has been linked to North Korea.

Geo-Political.title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
Geo-Political.summary: In her first public statement since surviving a September lethal injection attempt, US inmate Christa Pike stated she woke up confused and in pain. The failed execution marks a rare instance of a lethal injection procedure not resulting in death.

Geo-Political.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
Geo-Political.summary: Hundreds of people were evacuated from the Russian-occupied front-line town of Oleshky during a rare ceasefire agreed upon by Ukraine. Despite the ongoing dangers, hundreds of other residents chose to remain in the town.

Geo-Political.title: Police deployed during stand-off over control of top Poland court
Geo-Political.summary: Polish police were deployed during a stand-off regarding control of the country's top court. This escalation followed the government's decision to suspend two senior justices and pursue criminal charges against them.

Geo-Political.title: They strangled us, says founder of Russian newspaper shut under pressure from authorities
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of the independent Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta stated that authorities forced the prominent news outlet to shut down. Novaya Gazeta had operated for the past three decades before succumbing to this government pressure.

Data & Insights.title: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2011 and 2023, 496 million people in India rose above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day. According to a World Bank report, this shifted India's extreme poverty rate downward from 27.1% to 2.6%.

Data & Insights.title: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned that global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten India's access to critical resources. He urged the country to strengthen domestic capabilities, diversify imports, and build strategic buffers.

Data & Insights.title: West Asia conflict drives 15-20% surge in working capital demand at Indian banks, lifts corporate credit growth: Report
Data & Insights.summary: The conflict in West Asia increased working-capital demand at Indian banks by 15 to 20 percent due to rising raw-material costs and shipping delays. This surge in corporate borrowing, along with refinancing and acquisitions, helped drive loan growth during the September quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What does the proposed India-Mexico preferential trade agreement mean for Indian exporters?
Data & Insights.summary: A proposed preferential trade agreement could help Indian exporters secure tariff concessions in Mexico. These negotiated reductions would improve the price competitiveness of Indian products in the Mexican market.

Data & Insights.title: Economy can sustain high-growth trajectory in FY27, recent GST reforms to help: Finmin review
Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry's October review states that the Indian economy can maintain a high-growth trajectory in FY27, supported by recent GST reforms. However, the Department of Economic Affairs warned that persistent global uncertainties, such as elevated oil prices and inflation, require constant vigilance.

India.title: ISRO Launches Next-Gen Satellite To Strengthen Indigenous GPS System
India.summary: ISRO launched the NVS-03 satellite to strengthen the indigenous NavIC navigation system. This spacecraft is the third launch in the second-generation NVS series.

India.title: Amit Shah's 'Special' Offer To INDIA Bloc Before Gyanesh Kumar's 'Public Impeachment'
India.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah challenged Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav to discuss a specific issue during a specially convened parliamentary session. Shah stated at a Lucknow party event that the Bharatiya Janata Party has nothing to hide and is fully prepared for the debate.

India.title: Delhi Records Coldest October Day In 75 Years After Heavy Rain, Clean Air
India.summary: Delhi experienced its coldest October day in 75 years following heavy rain and clean air. The resulting drop in temperatures caused residents to wear warm clothes as the mercury fell well below normal.

India.title: BJP Leader's Singer Wife, A Kabir Bhajan Gone Viral, And The 'Jantar Mantar' That Wasn't
India.summary: A viral video of singer Sivasri Skandaprasad performing a Kabir bhajan was widely misinterpreted as a political jab at protests in Delhi. Scholars clarify that the saint-poet's original lyrics carried a much deeper spiritual meaning rather than a reference to the Jantar Mantar landmark.

India.title: AAP Claims Government Jobs Halting Punjab Migration, BJP Blames Visa Rules
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann claimed that government jobs are stopping young people from migrating abroad. Conversely, the BJP attributed the shift in migration trends to stricter foreign visa rules.

India.title: 'Does A Man Not Have Right To End Relationship?' Supreme Court On False Rape Cases
India.summary: The Supreme Court questioned whether a man has the right to end a relationship during a legal proceeding regarding false rape allegations. The bench clarified that ending a relationship does not make previously consensual sexual relations a crime.
